hooks.name: Docs Sync — API Routes

action.prompt:
A FastAPI route file was just saved. Inspect the route decorators,
   path, HTTP method, and request/response models in this file. Update
   the "API Reference" section of the top-level README.md to match: list
   each endpoint, its method, path, request body shape, and response
   shape. Do not touch any other section of the README. If the API
   Reference section doesn't exist yet, create it at the end of the file.

hooks.description: Keep README's API Reference section in sync with FastAPI route changes.
